data.name: Fadheel
data.gender_notes: Fadheel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is given a favor or a gift. The name Fadheel carries the meaning “Favor, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fadheel usually hope their child will grow to embody favor, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is generous and kind to others.
data.etymology: Fadheel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favor, Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadheel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فضيل
in_arabic.meaning: ذات فضل و كمال، نيكوكار، بڑے اچھے کام کرنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: فضيل نام کا مطلب ہے جس کے पास اچھائی اور خوبی ہے، جو نيكوكار ہے اور بڑے اچھے کام کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام فضل (Fadl) سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'فضل' یا 'اچھائی'۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، فضيل جیسے ناموں کو اچھے اخلاق اور عظیم کردار کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فضیل
in_urdu.meaning: ذات فضل و كمال، نیکوکار، بڑے اچھے کام کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیل نام کا مطلب ہے جس کے پاس اچھائی اور خوبی ہے، جو نیکوکار ہے اور بڑے اچھے کام کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام فضل (Fadl) سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'فضل' یا 'اچھائی'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، فضیل جیسے ناموں کو اچھے اخلاق اور عظیم کردار کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ज़ील
in_hindi.meaning: जिसके पास अच्छाई और خوبी है, नेककार, बड़े अच्छे काम करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ज़ील नाम का अर्थ है जिसके पास अच्छाई और सुंदरता है, जो नेक है और बड़े अच्छे काम करता है। यह नाम فضل (Fadl) से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है 'अच्छाई' या 'सुंदरता'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, फ़ज़ील जैसे नामों को अच्छे चरित्र और महान गुणों के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فضیل
in_pashto.meaning: د فضل او كمال لرونکی، نیكوكار، ډیر ښه كارونه كوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فضیل نوم معنی دے چې څوک د فضل او كمال څخه برخمن دی، نیكوكار دی او ډیر ښه كارونه كوي. دا نوم د فضل (Fadl) څخه مشتق شوی دی چې معنی یې 'فضل' یا 'ښه والی' ده. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو له مخې، فضیل په څیر نومونه د ښو اخلاقو او لویو ځانګړتیاوو نښه ګڼل كيږي.

in_english.name: Fadheel
in_english.meaning: Possessor of goodness, virtues, and excellent qualities
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fadheel originates from the Arabic root 'F-D-L' which signifies 'goodness', 'virtue', or 'excellence'. In Islamic tradition, names like Fadheel are highly regarded as they denote an individual of superior character, marked by their moral integrity, kindness, and good deeds. The name Fadheel implies a person who excels in virtues and is known for their benevolence and high moral standards. Historically, such names were bestowed upon individuals to reflect their good character and to inspire them to maintain high ethical values.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: فضیل (fa-dheel)

data.cultural_impact: The name Fadheel has its roots in the Arabic language, which is the language of the Islamic faith. In Arabic culture, giving and receiving favors or gifts is a significant gesture, often symbolizing goodwill, respect, and friendship. The occasional bestowal of a favor holds an esteemed place in the culture, as it is a reflection of good character and grace. Therefore, the name Fadheel suggests an individual who has a positive impact on those around them by granting favors and developing relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Fadheel can be traced back to the Islamic texts. The Prophet Mohammad (PBUH) stated, "It is not lawful for a man to becalled Fadhl (Virtuous) except if he is virtuous." This implies that those who possess the name Fadheel are expected to embody virtuous qualities through actions that benefit themselves and others. The prayers and supplications made by a person with this name are believed to be accepted more readily, as it is thought that God rewards a person based on their character and deeds. Overall, the name Fadheel is a constant reminder of the importance of moral character and generosity, as one who bears this name is expected to Bear Graces and favor not just materialistically but in terms of moral, spiritual, and emotional upliftment to those around him or her.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Favor, Generosity" symbolizes One who is given a favor or a gift.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fadheel serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of favor, generosity.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Fadheel ibn Marwan was the name of a famous Umayyad caliph who ruled in Damascus in the 7th century.
historical_references.context: Fadheel ibn Marwan was a significant figure in Islamic history as the Umayyad Caliph in Damascus during a time of political instability. He was known for his military prowess and his ability to maintain order in the region.
